title: UI: the viewport line colours (plain [f32; 3] consts) read the theme's token table
body:
Follow-up of #1120 (found during the #1120 family PRs #3990, #3992, #3993, #4072, #4073, #4207 and #4208).

## What is there now

After #4208, each `Color32` literal at a draw site in `crates/ui/src` reads a theme token, and the colour-literal guard (`crates/ui/tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs`) has only permanent rows. The guard counts `Color32` literals only. About 19 viewport line colours are plain-number `[f32; 3]` (or `[u8; 3]`) constants, and the guard cannot see them:

- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`: `VIEWPORT_BG`, `GRID_MINOR`, `GRID_MAJOR`, `REGION_RGB`, `CLEARANCE_RGB`, `RETRACT_RGB`, `CUT_RGB`, `PICK_RGB` (the move kinds `FEED_RGB`, `RAPID_RGB` and `PLUNGE_RGB` are in the verdict palettes of #4207 and stay ours).
- `crates/ui/src/sketch_overlay.rs`: `SKETCH_RGB`, `OPEN_END_RGB`.
- `crates/ui/src/work_envelope.rs`: `ENVELOPE_RGB`.
- `crates/ui/src/boundary_viz.rs`: `HOVER_RGB`.
- `crates/ui/src/align_pick_viz.rs`: `PICK_RGB8` (the same violet as `PICK_RGB`, in 0..255).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/colorvision.rs`: `EDGE_DARK`, `EDGE_WIRE`; `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ground_ink.rs`: `EDGE_WIRE_LIGHT` and the light-ground arms of `overlay_ink` (#698).

Most of these go to the shaders or to the overlay vertex colours. Several have a dark set and a light-ground set (#698), selected by the luminance of the viewport ground.

## Why it is a separate issue

#1120 counted the `Color32` sites (its estimate said 51). These constants are a different design:

- They are display sRGB floats for the GPU, not `Color32`.
- A ground-dependent pair needs the ground rule of #3993 (a theme key that is not set follows the ground when it flips).
- Some (`VIEWPORT_BG`, the grid) may be older copies of the `viewport` token and could be removed, not moved.
- `EDGE_DARK` and `EDGE_WIRE` are inputs of the colour-vision gate, so they may stay ours like the verdict palettes.

## Done means

- Each constant above is either a theme token (`Tokens` field, both columns with the old value, a theme-file key) or a named row of a table that stays ours, with the reason in a decision record.
- A guard (an extension of `colour_scan`, or a second scan) refuses a new plain-number colour array outside the token tables.
- Each colour renders the same as before in the dark and light theme, on both viewport grounds and in each colour-vision mode (asserted on the values; no snapshot PNG touched).

Suggested labels (I cannot set labels): `enhancement`, `area:ui`, `P6`, `effort:medium`.
